current_date: 2025 (title 'Local validation requirements for planning applications 2025'); council page says new requirements enforced from 1 January 2026
current_evidence: The council's 'What your application must include' page (last updated 1 October 2026, next review 4 December 2026) says 'The Council has approved an updated local validation checklist'. It links this 2025 PDF and six V1-2025 type checklists, and says applications will only be invalidated for non-compliance after 1 January 2026.

issues.detail: Many numbered local requirements in the 2025 list have no row of their own. The ones that hit common minor and residential schemes are: Affordable Housing Appraisal (10+ units, or sites with potential for 10+); Accommodation Schedule (proposals providing residential units, care homes, caravan and traveller plots); Energy Statement – Minor and Sustainability Statement – Minor (new minor residential of 1+ units, or new minor non-residential over 100 sq m; Grokbot's Energy/Sustainability row says major only); Materials (details of) (all developments involving building work); Shopfronts in Conservation Areas or Listed Buildings; Transport Statement (residential of 10-50 units); Parking Management Plan (all majors, residential over 5 units in a CPZ, on-site parking).
issues.evidence: 2025 list items 5, 10, 27(b), 39-40, 45, 57(b), 60, 9: e.g. 57(b) 'For all new Minor residential development of 1 or more units or all new Minor non-residential development greater than 100 sq.m.'; 60 'Applications proposing residential development of 10-50 units'.

issues.detail: Further 2025 local requirements are missing: Circular Economy Statement (GLA referable); Outline Construction Logistics Plan (all majors, smaller schemes with significant construction impact, sites on classified roads); Delivery and Servicing Plan (all majors, Class E(a)-(c) over 100 sq m, refuse store more than 10m from highway), which appears only glued into other rows' triggers; District Heating Assessment (major or over 100 sq m within 200m of a heat network); Large Scale Shared Living Management Plan (more than 50 bed-spaces); Marketing Strategy; Overheating Assessment (all major); Tall Building Assessment (10+ storeys outside Local Plan Fig 14.1 sites); Urban Greening Factor (all major excl. B2/B8); Noise and Vibration Assessment (no row of its own; it is folded into 'Odour / Dust / Vibration'); Demolition Method Statement (demolition in conservation areas, of listed or locally listed buildings, or in AQMAs).
issues.evidence: 2025 list items 17, 19, 22, 23, 24, 36, 39, 42, 44, 58, 63, e.g. 58 'Development of 10 or more storeys outside of the sites identified in Fig 14.1 of the Local Plan'; 63 'All major development (excluding B2/B8 commercial uses)'.

issues.detail: Habitats Regulations Assessment (Epping Forest SAC) has the Full planning trigger 'Screening and Appropriate Assessment will need to address this.', a fragment. The source requires it for any new dwelling (1+ units), HMO, student, care, caravan or gypsy/traveller residential anywhere in the borough, because the whole borough is within the 6.2km SAC zone, with extra requirements within 400m.
issues.evidence: Item 49 Project Level Habitats Regulations Assessment: new dwellings (1+ units), HMOs, student, care... 'whole borough within the 6.2km Epping Forest SAC zone'.

issues.detail: The Householder and Full planning 'Fire Statement' rows give only the national 18m / 7-storey Fire Statement trigger. The 2025 local list also requires a Planning Fire Safety Strategy or Reasonable Exception Statement for householder and non-major development (London Plan D12), and a Fire Statement for all major applications. Householders would wrongly conclude no fire document is needed.
issues.evidence: Item 29 'Fire Statement / Planning Fire Safety Strategy / Reasonable Exception Statement': 'All major applications; Householders & Non-major development' (also quoted in Grokbot's own LBC row).

issues.detail: Many triggers are fragments or belong to a different requirement. Householder and Full planning 'Flood Risk Assessment' and 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' are both 'with any SuDS strategy, Flood Risk Assessment, or Construction Logistics Plan.' (real FRA trigger: Flood Zones 2/3, critical drainage areas, basements in groundwater flood risk areas). Full 'Ground investigation / Basement Impact Assessment' carries the archaeology trigger ('groundworks within Tier 1 Archaeological Priority Areas'). Outline 'Archaeological Assessment' carries the Basement text. Outline 'Tall buildings / Wind' is Marketing Strategy text. Full 'Arboricultural' = 'line with BS5837 62.'. 'Contaminated Land' = 'is required Land Contamination Assessment. 35.'. 'Transport Assessment / Transport Statement' = 'content of a Transport Assessment for over 50'. Householder 'Heritage Statement' gives no trigger at all; the source says applications within or affecting conservation areas, listed or locally listed buildings, areas of special character, archaeological remains or SAMs.
issues.evidence: 2025 list item 31 FRA, 12 Archaeological DBA, 13 Basement Impact Assessment, 32 Heritage Statement, 59 Transport Assessment ('Major Applications for over 50 residential units; commercial over 1000 sq.m; schools, nurseries, hospitals, places of worship').

issues.detail: Rows are mislabelled because Grokbot matched keywords. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' (Householder, Full, Outline) is actually the Construction and Demolition Method Statement or Demolition Method Statement. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is actually the retail Sequential Test and Impact Assessment (edge or out-of-centre Class A, leisure over 200 sq m). 'Gypsy & Traveller information' (Outline) is actually the Purpose Built Student Housing Demand Study. Outline 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is a Lighting Assessment fragment ('significant external illumination.'). 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' under prior approval is Viability Appraisal content.
issues.evidence: Outline row trigger: 'Purpose Built Student Housing demand Study Requirement All applications for purpose-built student accommodation'; 'Sequential Test and Impact Assessment Proposals for new, or extension to, existing edge or out-of-centre Class A uses... in excess of 200 sqm'.

issues.detail: Grokbot also read the superseded 2023 list (Full National _ Local Validation Checklist 2023 update FINAL.docx), and 9 app-type rows plus several tab_items come from it rather than the 2025 list. Examples: Full planning Archaeology, Ecological Survey, Electric vehicle charging, Foul Sewage, Planning Obligations; LBC Lighting Assessment; the Change of use rows. The 2023 file limit of 5Mb conflicts with the 2025 limit of 10Mb in tab_items.
issues.evidence: Row sources ending 'Full%20National%20_%20Local%20Validation%20Checklist%202023%20update%20FINAL.docx'; tab_items 'documents must not exceed 5Mb' (2023) vs '10Mb' (2025).

issues.detail: 'Variation of condition s73' and 'Non-material amendment' are marked 'No specific local requirements', but the 2025 list has a dedicated item for these. A Planning Statement is required for variation or removal of conditions and amendments, and an Environmental Statement for s73/s96a amendments to EIA development. 'Works to trees' is also marked none. Five rows are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' (Planning Statement, Sequential Test, Viability, Planning Obligations, Housing mix) because their text mentions change of use. They are planning-application requirements, not prior approval ones.
issues.evidence: Item 7 'Sections 73 and 96a (Non-Material Amendments)'; item 47 Planning Statement: '...variation or removal of conditions and amendments'; item 28 Environmental Statement: 's73/s96a amendments to original EIA development'.

issues.detail: 40 Full planning rows carry 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning', even though most source triggers are scale-based and apply to outline too, and some apply to householder. Examples: Archaeological DBA ('All proposals involving groundworks within Tier 1 APAs'); Basement Impact Assessment ('All applications which include the construction, extension, or deepening of a basement'), which is a householder-relevant trigger; Surface Water Drainage ('All development proposals including buildings, non-permeable hard surfacing, or extensions').
issues.evidence: app_type_rows notes 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'.

issues.detail: tab_items and rows include process text and fragments. The tab_items include 'After that, it will be closed, and your application fee will be returned to you minus a £25 administration charge' (two versions), 'Other formats - Please convert the following formats into pdf format or a word document:' and a Lighting Assessment deliverable ('A lighting layout plan ... Lighting Reality file format') filed under Submission rules. Outline 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is encouragement text, not a validation requirement. Householder 'Highways / access details' quotes site-plan content plus 'Article 7 ... The correct fee'.
issues.evidence: Householder row trigger: 'public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking and open areas around buildings Policy / Drivers - Article 7 of The Town and Country Planning Development Management Procedure (England) (Order) 2015 - The correct fee, w...'

issues.detail: Several rows duplicate each other. Outline 'Ventilation / Extraction' and 'Odour / Dust / Vibration' have identical triggers. 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Highways / access details' repeat the same Site Plan fragment in every app type. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Flood Risk Assessment' share one fragment. Outline 'Retail / Town Centre' and 'Tall buildings / Wind' share the Marketing Strategy fragment. Drawing-standard tab_items are repeated from the 2023 and 2025 lists.
issues.evidence: Outline Ventilation and Odour triggers both 'Ventilation/ Extraction Statement (see also Noise and Vibration Assessment) Any proposal for the use of premises that require...'

issues.detail: The list date 2025-12-01 is taken from the upload-folder path. The document text only says '2025' in its title, and the council page says the updated list applies (invalidation) from 1 January 2026. The date basis should cite the page text.
issues.evidence: Page: 'the Council will only invalidate applications that do not comply with the new requirements after 1 January 2026'; PDF title 'Local validation requirements for planning applications 2025'.

issues.detail: The 'Prior Notification for Larger Home Extensions Checklist V1-2025' linked on the council page was not read or captured.
issues.evidence: Council page link: 'Prior Notification for Larger Home Extensions Checklist -V1-2025'.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Waltham Forest 2025 local list (enforced from 1 Jan 2026), but extraction is poor. Around 18 of the list's 65 numbered requirements (e.g. Affordable Housing Appraisal, minor Energy/Sustainability Statements, Materials, Urban Greening, Tall Building Assessment, Delivery and Servicing Plan) have no row. Many triggers are fragments or mislabelled, and some rows come from the superseded 2023 list. The Epping Forest SAC HRA and householder fire-safety triggers are misstated.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
